allowed_scope.purpose: Implement the smallest production foundation for the already-approved governed Python-to-Node stdio boundary, reusing Cline AgentRuntime mechanics without transferring LBE authority.
allowed_scope.implementation_changes: protocol/frame types and validation, Python-owned child-process lifecycle adapter, bounded Node worker bootstrap, exact Cline dependency pin/lock, and focused contract tests only; no TUI/MCP/provider expansion and no native Cline mutation/execution authority
allowed_actions: add Python-owned child-process lifecycle adapter with startup/shutdown/timeout/protocol-failure handling
add bounded Node worker bootstrap using @cline/agents at the audited compatible line
register/expose only allowlisted LBE-governed tool definitions to the worker
keep resolve_authorization and GovernedToolOrchestrator as exclusive execution authority
add exact Node/Cline dependency metadata and lockfile required by the worker

add focused tests for protocol validation, child lifecycle, native-tool exclusion, deny-before-execute boundary wiring, identity correlation, malformed-frame failure, and restart/idempotency safety where implementable in this foundation
run focused tests, implementation-gate validation, full regression if practical for changed owners, and git diff --check
update only directly related source/tests/package/acceptance files
